subject.title: fix(openai): align auth availability with effective routes

question: Should existing custom-endpoint, authored-transport, Completions, or explicitly Codex-pinned OpenAI setups be allowed to stop selecting Codex or fail closed when the effective route cannot be reproduced by the harness?
rationale: The implementation consistently enforces the new route contract, but accepting this user-visible compatibility transition requires maintainer intent rather than test inference.

options.title: Require upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the fail-closed route contract, but require exact current-main integration and fresh-install plus upgrade evidence before merge.

options.title: Preserve prior defaults
options.body: Retain compatibility by default and design a separately approved strict mode or migration path for incompatible routes.

options.title: Accept the transition
options.body: Merge the fail-closed behavior with explicit release-facing documentation that affected setups may need runtime configuration changes.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed route contract, but require exact current-main integration and fresh-install plus upgrade evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and the implementation series make this person the strongest available owner for the intended compatibility semantics.
